NES LAB PPU fix 1 — JSNES 2.1.0

The upstream jsnes.min.js is retained byte-for-byte. Its SHA-256 is:
84946f0dae4bcf3b2dfebe84ad3bfeb1dbcb413bd9b1a69e1f45910a95fd7b41

jsnes-patched.min.js is a locally modified derivative under Apache-2.0.
Build it with: python scripts/patch_jsnes.py

In src/ppu/index.js, renderSpritesPartially, the 8x16 sprite tile base was:
  (sprTile & 1) !== 0 ? (sprTile & 0xFE) - 1 + 256 : (sprTile & 0xFE)
The correction removes the extra subtraction:
  (sprTile & 0xFE) + ((sprTile & 1) ? 256 : 0)

For 8x16 NES sprites, bit 0 of the OAM tile byte selects pattern table
$0000/$1000; bits 7..1 select the even top tile. Bit 0 must not also
subtract a tile from that even base. The bottom tile is base + 1.
Both horizontal and vertical flip flags still apply unchanged.

The minified distribution changes one expression only. License in
JSNES-LICENSE.txt. Package provenance in README.txt.
Regression test: node tests/test_ppu.js
The test compares every tile byte (0..255), both pattern tables,
all four flip combinations, all pixels and all sprite palettes against
an independent 8x16 OAM addressing formula. It must fail on the original
upstream bundle and pass on the patched bundle.
